title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What are you doing tonight? Big blue winning?
Hanging with Sam. And yeah, they’re up by 10
Would you guys have any interest in throwing axes with me and my on-and-off, long-distance, ex-girlfriend in Ferndale around 11?
I am out to dinner with her now but she is heading back him soon because she works at 7 tomorrow morning
I’m trying to convince her to leave that job because that’s brutal
